title: Rampi language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Rampi is a language of Central and South Sulawesi, Indonesia. The main speakers are located in the Rampi district in North Luwu, besides that, the Rampi people also migrated to the north of Lake Poso who are known as Leboni dialect speakers.
